meanings.note: Declinable neuter noun meaning 'ainura', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

порадоваться.gloss: to rejoice, to be happy, to be glad

meanings.note: + за + accusative of person. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'радоваться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to rejoice, to be happy, to be glad', paired with 'радоваться'.
